cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your invisible guest is welcome at our wedding. I'll reserve places for invisible companions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her family can walk through walls. They tend to wander.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll rent a ballroom that follows them. Nobody should miss cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our ballroom can split itself when guests wander apart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll order a cake that multiplies with it. Every room deserves the first slice.

mechanism: A treats its former event pupil impossible accommodations as only the starting point for a larger promise of equal wedding hospitality.
confusable: Not ordinary generosity: each supernatural guest feature produces a more committed impossible provision with a clear inclusion reason.
comparison: Service engineering under a former teacher versus wedding host pushing an old pupil planner further.
seedUse: D163 invisible guests/wall-walking/splitting ballroom/multiplying cake; S05 hospitality training and partial praise.
